create_SegDataSample: create a SegDataSample instance to hold semantic segmentation ground truth and prediction data
set_gt_sem_seg: set the gt_sem_seg property on a SegDataSample with a PixelData object containing ground truth masks
set_pred_sem_seg: set the pred_sem_seg property on a SegDataSample with a PixelData object containing predicted segmentation masks
set_seg_logits: set the seg_logits property on a SegDataSample with a PixelData object containing predicted segmentation logits
review_SegDataSample_class: review the SegDataSample class and its gt_sem_seg, pred_sem_seg, and seg_logits properties for MMSegmentation data handling
